run_gpu_pose_error_evaluation: run the GPU-based 6D pose error evaluation script with mssd or mspd error types on BOP results
calculate_mssd_errors: calculate minimum symmetric surface distance errors for 6D pose estimates using GPU batch processing
calculate_mspd_errors: calculate minimum symmetric projected distance errors for 6D pose estimates using GPU batch processing
evaluate_bop_results_localization: evaluate BOP pose estimation results in localization mode by comparing estimated poses against ground truth
evaluate_bop_results_detection: evaluate BOP pose estimation results in detection mode with configurable visibility threshold for ground truth objects
